correctness.rationale: From the frozen RESULT.md, reconstruct the quotient ell_1^{p+1}/span(1,...,1,lambda), the projection polytope K=conv(±Pe_j), and polar weighted zero-sum cube section. The S_p average of any candidate quadratic form is admissible with no larger distortion, so q_c exhausts the unrestricted optimum up to symmetry. Computing q_c on projected generators gives R(c)=max(c,(p−1)/p+lambda²c/p²), meeting at c0=p(p−1)/(p²−lambda²). Exhausting cube-section vertices by parity gives S(c)=E+1/c for odd p and max(p,E+1/c) for even p, with the second branch crossing ordered after c0. On (0,c0] product strictly decreases, and on [c0,∞) increases. Therefore BM²=1+c0E for every p≥2, 0<lambda≤1, and differentiation gives the opposite signs by p parity. Independent exact rational enumeration of the polar vertices and primal points for p=2..7 and lambda=1,1/2,2/3 agreed in 18 cases; these bounded checks support but do not replace the infinite proof. Endpoint lambda→0 is excluded because dimension changes after collapse.
residual_risks: No treatment of arbitrary weighted cycles or complex scalar field; no uniqueness of an optimum quadratic beyond the averaged family is claimed.
